title: X
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 1999, the young esper Kamui Shiro returns to Tokyo to face his destiny as the one who will decide humanity's fate. The Dragons of Heaven protect spiritual barriers that hold back the apocalypse, while the Dragons of Earth seek to destroy them so earthquakes can cleanse the planet of humanity. When Kamui chooses Heaven to protect his childhood friends, his friend Fuma becomes his opposite and murders his sister Kotori; the war devastates Tokyo, and the manga remains unfinished.
life_message: People choose their own destiny between good and evil, and what one wishes for most decides the fate of those one loves.

content.note: Gruesome murders, deaths of many characters and earthquakes destroying Tokyo (Wikipedia); AniList tags Gore; ANN reportedly found the imagery too disturbing for its magazine.
Apocalyptic tragedy, horror-based spells, fatalism (Wikipedia; AniList Tragedy, Post-Apocalyptic).
Boys' love subplot between Subaru and Seishiro, homoerotic tones (Wikipedia; MangaUpdates Boys' Love as a Subplot); a heroine loses powers after a sexual relationship (Wikipedia).
Trauma, a dreamer in a permanent coma, split personality (Wikipedia; AniList Dissociative Identities, MangaUpdates Split Personality).
